query_text: Where can I get tickets for the next NBA game?

messages.content: Where can I get tickets for the next NBA game?

message.content:
You can get **NBA game tickets** from the **official NBA ticket site**, **Ticketmaster**, or major resale marketplaces like **SeatGeek**, **StubHub**, **Vivid Seats**, and **Gametime**.[3][6][2][4][1][10]

If you want the most direct option, the NBA’s official ticket site says it offers **single-game tickets, season packages, group tickets, special offers, and official resale**.[3] Ticketmaster is also listed as the **Official Ticket Marketplace of the NBA**.[6]

If you mean the **next NBA game**, ESPN’s schedule shows the upcoming matchup and links ticket info for games on the schedule.[5]
